individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of microscopy images (pseudocoloured photoactivation time-lapse frames), not a plot of averaged data.

Panel B graphs are line/scatter plots of measured intensity decay over time (with fitted model curves) and insets of averaged early time-point data; line/scatter-type plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A shows microscopy images, no error bars apply.

FAIL - The inset graphs display error bars on the averaged early time-point data points (red/green data sets), but the caption only states these are 'average early time points responses' without specifying what the error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
